title: Built-in Wi‑Fi and Bluetooth connectivity issues
summary: Reviews in this topic center on unstable built-in Wi‑Fi, eSIM, and Bluetooth connections, with repeated mentions of dropped links, slow pairing, weak signal, and occasional hotspot access issues.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe built-in Wi‑Fi, eSIM, and Bluetooth that disconnect, pair inconsistently, connect slowly, show weak signal, or require resets and manual reconnection.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention requests for a Wi‑Fi hotspot or note inability to use or connect devices without enough context to confirm a clear sentiment.

limitations: Several example fragments are truncated or vague, limiting detail on the exact failure mode.
The topic mixes Wi‑Fi hotspot, eSIM, and Bluetooth pairing issues, which are related but not identical systems.
Undetermined examples do not provide enough context to separate product failure from settings, service activation, or user action in every case.
